title: Monthly Contribution - September 2024
html:
💡
Opened and merged 2 PRs to Prysm

Prysm

#1

  • Added Electra support for this endpoint: /eth/v2/debug/beacon/states/{state_id}
  • Opened at September 20th, Merged at September 21st.

#2

  • Prysm chose gRPC for the communication at first, but they have been slowly deprecating its usage, and implementing RESTful HTTP API.
  • #14089 removes gRPC gateway, but hack/update-go-pbs.sh file still updates and generates *pb.gw.go files.
  • This PR says farewell to all gRPC gateway files.
  • Opened at September 21st, Merged at September 21st.
